body.title: Implement host-owned native process leases
body.summary: Add proposed src/daemon/threads/review-processes.ts for per-review/incarnation native-command reservations, owned cancellation, bounded output/backpressure and confirmed-disposal tracking. Reuse current process-group/shell lifecycle primitives; make unknown settlement distinct from verified disposal and keep lightweight host lifecycle work separate from worker-side review parsing.
acceptanceChecks: Create each host lease/cancellation handle before spawn; reject closing incarnations and conflicting operation replay, and make identical operation replay non-spawning.
No native command starts without a durable open-intent receipt for the same registered review/incarnation/lease; worker death during reservation/spawn cannot lose the owner handle.
Owned abort, process exit, stream-consumer loss and child/group cleanup produce explicit confirmed/unknown outcomes; sent signals and settlement timers are not disposal proof.
Unknown disposal retains only the target resource fence; other reviews remain usable and replacement provider dispatch stays blocked.
Existing permission/provenance checks and process-group semantics remain in force; daemon-only native broker is not repurposed for arbitrary children.

tests.name: src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-processes.test.ts: host leases precede spawn and enforce owner-bound replay and disposal
src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-processes.test.ts: worker loss and unknown child cleanup fence only the owning review
